about: Source features that the evidence shows are wrong. 'exclude': they stay in the master dataset (flagged, confidence low) but are kept out of the game map; a feature is only excluded when independent evidence contradicts it. 'heights': storey counts and heights that reference photos contradict (the footprint is not touched). 'reclass': ground areas whose mapped use the reference photos and the owner contradict (the outline is kept). 'reshape': an outline that sits off the building Google Open Buildings and the owner's imagery show is replaced by a measured ring (game metres); the OSM id and tags stay. 'addAreas': ground areas the owner's imagery shows and the sources lack (woods round the School of Law and International House), measured on the registered imagery. 'addWays': ways the owner's photos show and the sources lack (Commonwealth's stairway from the gate houses to the forecourt, Volta's forecourt); their ends are inserted into the way they meet so the network stays connected, except an end marked 'open' (at the foot of a flight of steps up to a door).
